mapper.select: select t1.bucket_time as collect_time, t1.cpu_usage_avg as cpu_usage, t1.process_cpu_usage_avg as process_cpu_usage, t1.heap_used_avg as heap_used, t1.heap_max_avg as heap_max, t1.nonheap_used_avg as nonheap_used, t1.threads_live_avg as threads_live, 0 as threads_blocked, t1.gc_count_sum as gc_count, t1.gc_pause_ms_sum as gc_pause_ms, t1.qps_avg as qps, t1.p95_ms_max as p95_ms, t1.error_rate_avg as error_rate, t1.pool_active_max as pool_active, t1.pool_pending_max as pool_pending, t1.pool_max_avg as pool_max, t1.disk_free_min as disk_free from sys_metric_rollup t1 where t1.granularity = #{granularity} and t1.bucket_time >= #{start} and t1.bucket_time < #{end} order by t1.bucket_time
mapper.insert:
insert into sys_metric_rollup (granularity, bucket_time, cpu_usage_avg, process_cpu_usage_avg, heap_used_avg, heap_used_max, heap_max_avg, nonheap_used_avg, threads_live_avg, threads_live_max, gc_count_sum, gc_pause_ms_sum, qps_avg, qps_max, p95_ms_max, error_rate_avg, error_rate_max, pool_active_max, pool_pending_max, pool_max_avg, disk_free_min) select '1h', from_unixtime(floor(unix_timestamp(t1.bucket_time) / 3600) * 3600), round(avg(t1.cpu_usage_avg), 2), round(avg(t1.process_cpu_usage_avg), 2), round(avg(t1.heap_used_avg)), max(t1.heap_used_max), round(avg(t1.heap_max_avg)), round(avg(t1.nonheap_used_avg)), round(avg(t1.threads_live_avg)), max(t1.threads_live_max), ifnull(sum(t1.gc_count_sum), 0), ifnull(sum(t1.gc_pause_ms_sum), 0), round(avg(t1.qps_avg), 2), max(t1.qps_max), max(t1.p95_ms_max), round(avg(t1.error_rate_avg), 2), max(t1.error_rate_max), max(t1.pool_active_max), max(t1.pool_pending_max), round(avg(t1.pool_max_avg)), min(t1.disk_free_min) from sys_metric_rollup t1 where t1.granularity = '5m' and t1.bucket_time >= #{start} and t1.bucket_time < #{end}
group by from_unixtime(floor(unix_timestamp(t1.bucket_time) / 3600) * 3600)
